CHAPTER 8 · ITEM 11 / 13

Tax size, time and subsidies

Subsidy equilibrium補貼均衡

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Analyze a per-unit subsidy: Ps − Pb = subsidy; quantity typically rises, buyers pay less, sellers receive more, and government expenditure is subsidy times quantity.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

補貼令 Ps 比 Pb 高 s。用兩個有效價格聯立供需；一般競爭模型下交易量增加，政府支出為 s 乘補貼後交易量。

A unit subsidy creates Ps−Pb=s. Sellers receive more than buyers pay; supply and demand meet at those separate effective prices. In the ordinary competitive model, quantity rises and government spends s×Qsub.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Qs=Ps,Qd=100−Pb,s=20. Ps=Pb+20 gives Pb=40,Ps=60,Q=60; government spends 1,200.

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Subsidy per unit=3, traded quantity=50. Government spending? 政府支出？
